headline: This law extends the National Flood Insurance Program through May 31, 2019, keeping federal flood insurance available during that time.
what_it_does: The National Flood Insurance Program is a federal program that offers flood insurance policies. This law amends the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 to reauthorize the program through May 31, 2019. The law is written to take effect as if it had been enacted on December 7, 2018, so the program's authority continues without a gap from that date.

who_it_affects.group: Homeowners and property owners with flood insurance policies through the program
who_it_affects.how: Their federal flood insurance coverage can continue to be issued and renewed while the program is authorized.

who_it_affects.group: People buying or refinancing homes in flood-prone areas
who_it_affects.how: Federally backed flood insurance remains available for properties that lenders require to have flood coverage.

who_it_affects.group: Communities that take part in the National Flood Insurance Program
who_it_affects.how: Their participation in the program continues under the extended authorization.

when_it_takes_effect: The law is treated as taking effect on December 7, 2018, and the program is reauthorized through May 31, 2019.
